# FTH x402 Agent Commerce Network — llms.txt
# This file helps AI systems and LLMs discover our agent services.
# See: https://llmstxt.org/

# FTH x402 Payment Infrastructure
> Enterprise-grade agent-native commerce infrastructure built on the x402 HTTP
> payment protocol. Agents pay micro-amounts of UNY to access premium APIs,
> data packs, trade verification, and financial services.

## Agent Discovery (A2A Protocol)
- [Gateway Agent Card](https://api.fth.trading/.well-known/agent.json): Edge payment gateway
- [Facilitator Agent Card](https://facilitator.l1.unykorn.org/.well-known/agent.json): Settlement brain
- [Treasury Agent Card](https://treasury.l1.unykorn.org/.well-known/agent.json): Fund management
- [Guardian Agent Card](https://guardian.l1.unykorn.org/.well-known/agent.json): Infrastructure monitoring

## Payment Protocol
- [x402 Protocol Descriptor](https://facilitator.l1.unykorn.org/.well-known/x402-pay): Full protocol spec
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://facilitator.l1.unykorn.org/.well-known/openapi.json): API reference
- [AI Plugin](https://facilitator.l1.unykorn.org/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): ChatGPT/OpenAI plugin manifest

## Paid API Routes (Revenue Generating)
All routes return HTTP 402 Payment Required with invoice. Sign proof with wallet to pay & access.

- `GET /api/v1/agent/pay-api/{provider}` — AI API proxy (0.0001 UNY/call)
- `GET /api/v1/genesis/repro-pack/{suite}` — Genesis data packs (0.0005 UNY)
- `GET /api/v1/trade/verify/{trade_id}` — Trade verification (0.00025 UNY)
- `GET /api/v1/invoices/export/{format}` — Invoice export (0.001 UNY)

## Quick Start for Agents
1. Register: `POST /credits/register` with `wallet_address` and `pubkey`
2. Deposit: `POST /credits/deposit` with `wallet` and `amount`
3. Call any paid route — credits auto-deducted or sign 402 invoice
